title: Deep Learning Analyses to Delineate the Molecular Remodeling Process after Myocardial Infarction.
authors: Iborra-Egea, Oriol; Galvez-Monton, Carolina; Prat-Vidal, Cristina; Roura, Santiago; Soler-Botija, Carolina; Revuelta-Lopez, Elena; Ferrer-Curriu, Gemma; Segu-Verges, Cristina; Mellado-Bergillos, Araceli; Gomez-Puchades, Pol; Gastelurrutia, Paloma; Bayes-Genis, Antoni
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习分析心肌梗死后的基因表达数据，聚焦心脏重塑的分子过程，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Specific proteins and processes have been identified in post-myocardial infarction (MI) pathological remodeling, but a comprehensive understanding of the complete molecular evolution is lacking. We generated microarray data from swine heart biopsies at baseline and 6, 30, and 45 days after infarction to feed machine-learning algorithms. We cross-validated the results using available clinical and experimental information. MI progression was accompanied by the regulation of adipogenesis, fatty acid metabolism, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition. The infarct core region was enriched in processes related to muscle contraction and membrane depolarization. Angiogenesis was among the first morphogenic responses detected as being sustained over time, but other processes suggesting post-ischemic recapitulation of embryogenic processes were also observed. Finally, protein-triggering analysis established the key genes mediating each process at each time point, as well as the complete adverse remodeling response. We modeled the behaviors of these genes, generating a description of the integrative mechanism of action for MI progression. This mechanistic analysis overlapped at different time points; the common pathways between the source proteins and cardiac remodeling involved IGF1R, RAF1, KPCA, JUN, and PTN11 as modulators. Thus, our data delineate a structured and comprehensive picture of the molecular remodeling process, identify new potential biomarkers or therapeutic targets, and establish therapeutic windows during disease progression.
abstract_zh: 心肌梗死后（post-myocardial infarction, MI）病理重塑中已鉴定出特定蛋白质和过程，但对其完整分子演变的全面理解仍缺乏。我们生成了猪心脏活检组织在基线和梗死后6、30、45天的微阵列数据，以输入机器学习算法。我们利用可用的临床和实验信息对结果进行了交叉验证。MI进展伴随脂肪生成、脂肪酸代谢和上皮-间质转化的调控。梗死核心区域富集了与肌肉收缩和膜去极化相关的过程。血管生成是最早检测到的形态发生反应之一，并随时间持续存在，但也观察到其他提示缺血后胚胎发生过程重演的现象。最后，蛋白质触发分析确定了每个时间点介导各过程的关键基因，以及完整的 adverse 重塑反应。我们对这些基因的行为进行了建模，生成了MI进展整合作用机制的描述。该机制分析在不同时间点存在重叠；源蛋白与心脏重塑之间的共同通路涉及IGF1R、RAF1、KPCA、JUN和PTN11作为调节因子。因此，我们的数据描绘了分子重塑过程的结构化全面图景，识别了新的潜在生物标志物或治疗靶点，并确定了疾病进展期间的治疗窗口。
